_note: requests-municipality-per-contact (D1, D2): the municipalities one desk serves, and the municipality a client, contact or ticket belongs to. A label, not a tenancy boundary: OpenRegister's organisation stays the access boundary. Client moves to 1.8.0 (1.7.0 is taken by products-price-lists), contact to 1.2.0, ticket to 1.8.0.

servedMunicipality.title: Municipality
servedMunicipality.description: A municipality one desk serves: its name, its CBS municipality code and, when it has one, its portal.
servedMunicipality.x-notes: requests-municipality-per-contact D2. Declarative data (ADR-031): a functional administrator keeps the list. The portal stamps the municipality whose portalTenantId is the tenant a request came in through. The slug is servedMunicipality, not municipality, because a schema slug is global per organisation and municipality is a name other apps may use.

name.title: Name
name.description: The municipality's name, such as Goes.

code.title: Municipality code
code.description: The four digit CBS municipality code, such as 0664.

portalTenantId.title: Portal
portalTenantId.description: The portal tenant whose requests belong to this municipality; empty when it has no portal of its own.

organisation.title: Organisation
